payload.description:
## Context
Full-queue triage + a 30-item uncertain review session showed that mechanical auto-reject and dedupe carry the operator-time win today. Uncertain-lane rationales are mostly factual inventory (domain, item id, “no accepted match”) and were **not** specific enough to decide from without opening the source.

## Goal
Lead each uncertain prospect with 1–2 sentences grounded in checkable corpus facts: named accepted refs, category/coverage gaps, citation links, or summary overlap — not “none matched closely.”

## Acceptance
- In a hand-checked sample of uncertain prospects, an operator can accept or reject from the rationale alone more often than today
- Still no auto-accept; exploratory remains exempt from history-based scoring
payload.title: Ground uncertain-lane rationales in corpus connections
